chunks.why: Rich but hated miser; rejects nephew's invitation with 'Bah! Humbug' on cold Christmas Eve.
Rebuffs charity gentlemen with 'surplus population'; drives caroler from door; deepens isolation.
Melancholy solitary dinner; sees Marley's face in knocker; ghost's chains approach through gloomy house.
Marley's fettered ghost confronts him with damnation; Scrooge falls terrified to his knees.
Marley warns of three haunting spirits; Scrooge quaking, dreads visits, first spirit arrives.
Ghost of Past shows lonely boyhood; Scrooge weeps for forgotten self, regret stirs beneath pain.
Sister Fan brings him home; Fezziwig's warm ball; reliving loved memories with unfamiliar joy.
Belle releases him; his younger self already ruled by Gain; love lost to golden idol.
Sees Belle's happy family that could have been his; begs 'I cannot bear it,' flees spirit.
Ghost of Present arrives jovial; Scrooge submissively learns amid Christmas abundance and street cheer.
Witnesses Cratchit household's warmth despite poverty; first sees Tiny Tim with crutch.
Told Tim will die; his 'surplus population' words thrown back; Mrs. Cratchit calls him odious.
Sees miners, lighthouse, ship keeping Christmas; nephew's laughing party; heart softens further.
Nephew toasts him with pity not anger; Scrooge caught up in games, begging to stay.
Named 'disagreeable animal' Uncle Scrooge; Ignorance and Want revealed; silent Phantom of Future looms.
Businessmen speak of an unnamed dead man with indifferent jokes; thieves gather at Old Joe's.
Watches scavengers barter his own bed-curtains and shirt stripped from his corpse; unmourned death.
Debtors relieved by his death; Tiny Tim has died; Cratchits grieve while Scrooge sees consequence.
Reads own name on grave, vows change; wakes reprieved in his own bed, laughing and weeping.
Sends turkey to Cratchits, gives generously, welcomed at nephew's, raises Bob's wages; Tim lives; redeemed.
